Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M.Nagaprasanna
 Oral Order

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.1828/2025 for
offences punishable under Sections 498A, 324, 504 and 506 of the Ipc and under Sections 3 and 4
of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Smt. Madhumalathi S., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. K. Nageswarappa,
learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. M.E. Mohan Kumar, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a joint memo along with an affidavit.

The joint memo reads as follows:
"JOINT MEMO

The petitioner and the Respondent above named humbly submits as follows:-
1] The petitioner and Respondent submits that, in lieu of settlement before the Mediation Centre, the petitioner had deposited the entire settlement amount of Rs.
75 Lakhs to the Respondent No.2 before the Hon'ble Family Court, upon production of Receipts for having remitted the entire NC: 2026:KHC:5188 HC-KAR amount by the petitioner, the Hon'ble V Addl.

Principal Family Judge was pleased to dispose off the petition in their vide order dated 20/09/2025 and granted relief as prayed in MC.No.2891/2025, hence in lieu of the above settlement the Respondent No.2 and petitioner have compromised their dispute and the Respondent No.2 has no intention to prosecute the petitioner any further.

WHEREFORE, the petitioner and the Respondent No.2 humbly prays that this Hon'ble court may be pleased to record the Joint Memo and be pleased to dispose off the above case in accordance with law, in the interest of justice."
4.

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the joint memo and close the proceedings against the petitioner in the subject petition.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER (i) Criminal Petition is disposed.
